usage: The word 繼父 (gai3 fu6) is used to refer to a stepfather, which means a man who is married to one's mother but is not their biological father.
It is a noun and usually appears as a subject or object in sentences.
You can use 繼父 to talk about family relationships when describing living arrangements or family dynamics.
In conversation, 繼父 is often used with possessive markers like 'my' (我嘅 ngo5 ge3) to specify whose stepfather is being talked about.
It is not typically used as a verb or adjective, only as a noun.
